dream warriors.bio: Toronto hip-hop group Dream Warriors, formed by King Lou and Capital Q, became a pioneering force in Canadian jazz rap with an inventive blend of hip-hop, jazz and reggae influences.

dubmatique.bio: Montréal group Dubmatique is a foundational francophone Canadian hip-hop act whose platinum-selling work helped open the mainstream Québec market to rap in the 1990s.

econoline crush.bio: Vancouver industrial-rock band Econoline Crush blends hard rock with electronic production, carrying a Canadian alternative-rock catalogue that stretches from the 1990s into new material today.

elaquent.bio: Guelph, Ontario producer Elaquent, born Sona Elango, is a leading figure in Canadian beat music whose sample-rich instrumental hip-hop draws from J Dilla, DJ Premier and electronic experimentation.

elise estrada.bio: Filipino-Canadian singer Elise Estrada built a pop and R&B career after moving to Vancouver, releasing a catalogue of radio-friendly solo music beginning in the 2000s.

enima.bio: Algerian-born Montréal rapper Enima, born Samir Slimani, developed a francophone street-rap catalogue shaped by Québec hip-hop, drill and French rap influences.

eternia.bio: Ottawa-born Canadian rapper Eternia is a two-time Juno-nominated lyricist whose independent career spans solo work, collaborations and a long-running presence in Toronto's hip-hop community.
